drivers: tobacco: quit within the last 5 years
rationale: Only debit is tobacco quit within five years (Standard band; bars preferred classes). Build, BP, lipids, A1c, family history, occupation, avocation, driving, liver and sleep apnea all carry zero. Total cover $2.0M exceeds the 25x income multiple ($1.7M) by about 18%; the manual refers this to judgement. Used judgement: the excess is modest on a long-duration term for a 40-year-old in his earning years, so accepted as applied at Standard.
